name: Primal Chord
descriptionTemplate:
随机造成 [Damage:Arg1] 点{穿刺伤害} 3 次，每造成 1 次伤害{偷取}目标 [Arg2] 点{力量}。选择手中 1 张不具有「乐音」的非消耗且非衍生的指令卡添加「{回环乐音}」。每次若没有手牌可被添加，改为额外造成 3 次伤害。
{overlay:Crescendo}
lore: Where does music originate? From divine rituals, from farmers' chants, from primal screams, from the warble of spring birds, from pine winds and ocean waves, from the tremors of the earth and the collapse of mountains... or perhaps from the whispers of gods in the chaos of the universe.

patch.descriptionTemplate: Randomly deal [Damage:Arg1] {Pierce DMG} 3 times, {Stealing} [Arg2] {STR▼} each time. Choose 1 non-Derived Command Card in hand that does not have {Exhaust}, {Rondino}, or {Crescendo}, and add {Rondino} to it. If there are no cards in your hand which qualify, deal DMG 3 more times.
